description: Multi-post blog or publication site: blog index with featured/list/grid layouts + per-post pages with editorial typography. Optional about/contact/legal support pages.

inputModel.notes: Each post needs at minimum { slug, title, contentHtml, date }. Pass contentHtml as ready-to-render HTML (markdown rendering happens upstream of producer).

dataPolicy.reason: Blog content is the product — fabricated posts mislead readers and SEO. Producer refuses to invent post content.
dataPolicy.minimum: At least 1 real post with title + content + date.
dataPolicy.demoMode: Use demo_mode=true to allow a single placeholder post for layout preview; producer emits a warning.

languageSupport.notes: Producer is language-agnostic for posts — pass content in any language; framing strings (nav, footer, eyebrows) come from i18n.
